reference_text:
InternPE
IPI#88816
Internship Domain:
valuable learning opportunity for you
It's 4 WEEKS program
https://internpe.in/
Hr@internpe.in
LET'S START
Web Development, 05/10/2026-01/11/2026 (4 WEEKS program).
Positive: email domain matches website; QR/link https://internpe.in/verify.html (fetch and report whether it works; do not assume).
ISO 9001:2015, MSME, AICTE logos without numbers.
Missing: letter issue date, stipend/unpaid statement, printed signatory name.
Source image is a social-media screenshot with UI overlays.

notes.title: Certification claims need confirmation
notes.quote: ISO 9001:2015, MSME, AICTE logos without numbers.
notes.explanation: The supplied notes describe badges without supporting numbers. No logo was inspected and no issuing authority was contacted.

notes.title: Core offer terms need clarification
notes.quote: Missing: letter issue date, stipend/unpaid statement, printed signatory name.
notes.explanation: These omissions are reported in the supplied notes. Ask for the complete dated offer and compensation terms; missing wording alone does not establish fraud.

notes.title: Contact domain is consistent in the reference
notes.quote: Hr@internpe.in
notes.explanation: The supplied email and URL use internpe.in. Matching text does not authenticate an email or the issuer.

notes.title: Original document unavailable
notes.quote: Source image is a social-media screenshot with UI overlays.
notes.explanation: The screenshot was described but not supplied. OCR, image inspection and verification-link checks did not run.

questions: Who signs and authorizes this exact offer?
Is the program paid, unpaid or paid training, and what are all charges?
What are the badge registration numbers and official verification pages?
Who supervises the four weeks, and what feedback is delivered?
Can the issuer confirm this reference number through an independently obtained contact?

reference_text:
internship studio
Common Internship Test (CIT)
Training & Internship Certificate
Internship Coordinator
www.internshipstudio.com
successful completion of the training course and submission of the final project
Our training sessions
Dated 30th July 2024, Java Internship, 6 months from 16th August 2024, signed Internship Coordinator, Pune address, www.internshipstudio.com.
Missing: stipend/unpaid statement, contact email/phone, CIN.
Positives: named coordinator, physical address, consistent website domain.
Source image has a video-caption overlay.
identifying_phrases: successful completion of the training course and submission of the final project

fields.Location: Pune address described; not independently checked

notes.title: Training versus employment needs clarification
notes.quote: successful completion of the training course and submission of the final project
notes.explanation: The supplied wording describes course and project completion. Training can be legitimate; establish whether this is employment or an educational program.

notes.title: Compensation and contact terms are incomplete
notes.quote: Missing: stipend/unpaid statement, contact email/phone, CIN.
notes.explanation: The reference notes report missing details. A CIN is only applicable to the relevant entity type; its absence alone is not a fraud indicator.

notes.title: Defined program dates in the reference
notes.quote: Dated 30th July 2024, Java Internship, 6 months from 16th August 2024
notes.explanation: These are concrete terms to confirm with the issuer. They have not been checked against an original document.

notes.title: Certificate conditions are stated
notes.quote: Training & Internship Certificate
notes.explanation: The reference identifies the certificate type. Its wording is not evidence of accreditation or employer recognition.

questions: Is this a training course or a role performing work for an employer?
What are the total charges, refund policy and any stipend?
Who is the supervisor and which team will review the work?
What must be completed to obtain each certificate?
Can the coordinator confirm the exact dates and provide full written terms?

reference_text:
OASIS INFOBYTE
OIB/SIP12907
Web Development and Designing
learning opportunity for you
Team Oasis Infobyte
contact@oasisinfobyte.in
www.oasisinfobyte.com
INTERNSHIP OFFER LETTER
Ref OIB/SIP12907, dated 7/2/2022, Web Development and Designing in our fellowship.
Email contact@oasisinfobyte.in vs website www.oasisinfobyte.com: domain mismatch.
Emblem of India and MSME logo, no registration number or verification link.
Missing: stipend/unpaid statement, start/end dates or duration, named signatory, postal address, phone, CIN.
you will acknowledge your obligation to perform all work allocated to you
Closing paragraph near-duplicates InternPe's.

notes.title: Different email and website domains
notes.quote: Email contact@oasisinfobyte.in vs website www.oasisinfobyte.com: domain mismatch.
notes.explanation: The two supplied domains differ. An organization can own both; their common ownership and authority have not been verified.

notes.title: Certification claims need confirmation
notes.quote: Emblem of India and MSME logo, no registration number or verification link.
notes.explanation: This is an observation supplied in the reference notes, not an image analysis or registry check performed here.

notes.title: Program terms are incomplete in the reference
notes.quote: Missing: stipend/unpaid statement, start/end dates or duration, named signatory, postal address, phone, CIN.
notes.explanation: Request the complete original and program-specific terms. These omissions have not been independently established.

notes.title: Template similarity was not measured
notes.quote: Closing paragraph near-duplicates InternPe's.
notes.explanation: This is a supplied observation. The full letters are unavailable, so no similarity percentage or plagiarism conclusion is produced.

questions: Can the operator confirm ownership of both the .in and .com domains?
What are the start/end dates and stipend or unpaid terms?
Who signs the offer and supervises the program?
What official records support the badges described in the reference?
What are all charges and certificate completion conditions?

reference_text:
Tata Consultancy Services
TATA CONSULTANCY PVT.LTD.
For Tata Consultancy Services Ltd.
CIN:L22210MH1995PLC084781
global.marketing@tcs.com
Offer of Appointment Letter
Your salary will be Rs 25,000/- Net earning
assets allocated to you needs to be submitted before exiting
Offer of Appointment Letter dated 02/Nov/2022, position SRO, join 6 Nov 2022.
selected at our client TATA CONSULTANCY PVT.LTD.
letterhead Private Limited vs signature Ltd.
addressee differs from the I Accept signatory
Positives: email and website domains consistent; no payment request; CIN present (link to MCA, do NOT assert a match unless verified).
It is a job appointment, not an internship.
identifying_phrases: Your salary will be Rs 25,000/- Net earning
assets allocated to you needs to be submitted before exiting

notes.title: Issuer–client relationship is unclear
notes.quote: selected at our client TATA CONSULTANCY PVT.LTD.
notes.explanation: The supplied reference describes a sender claiming this brand while also describing it as a client. Establish whether an authorized staffing agency issued the offer.

notes.title: Entity wording differs
notes.quote: letterhead Private Limited vs signature Ltd.
notes.explanation: The supplied notes describe inconsistent legal-name wording. Verify the actual issuer against official company records; this is not an accusation about TCS.

notes.title: Acceptance identity needs review
notes.quote: addressee differs from the I Accept signatory
notes.explanation: The reference reports a name mismatch. Names are omitted, and the original letter is required to confirm the issue.

notes.title: Structured employment details are supplied
notes.quote: Your salary will be Rs 25,000/- Net earning
notes.explanation: A stated salary is a concrete term to verify. Neither a printed CIN nor a matching domain authenticates the letter.

questions: Which legal entity is the employer and which is the client?
Can TCS recruitment confirm this offer or the issuing agency?
Why do the letterhead and signature use different entity forms?
Can the issuer supply a corrected acceptance page for the intended recipient?
Can official recruitment confirm the role, salary, joining date and contact channel?

reference_text:
Welcome to Wipro Limited
Data Management Specialist
Your employment with Wipro Limited India will commence on
probation for a period of 12 months
Annexure III - Salary Offer Sheet
Variable Pay
2. Other Benefits
Dated September 16, 2024, Data Management Specialist, Hyderabad, commencing 8-Oct-2024.
Only page 1 provided (cuts off at 2. Other Benefits); no sender email, CIN or signatory visible; Annexures III and VI not provided.
No payment request. Conditions to read, not red flags: 12-month probation, transfer clause, 24x7 shifts incl. night shift, conditional on degree requirements.
identifying_phrases: Your employment with Wipro Limited India will commence on
probation for a period of 12 months

fields.Compensation: Salary annexure referenced; amounts not provided

notes.title: Defined role and joining date
notes.quote: Dated September 16, 2024, Data Management Specialist, Hyderabad, commencing 8-Oct-2024.
notes.explanation: The supplied reference contains specific employment terms. These are positive structural indicators, not authentication.

notes.title: Compensation structure is referenced
notes.quote: Annexure III - Salary Offer Sheet
notes.explanation: The reference mentions a salary annexure, but its contents were not supplied. No salary amount is inferred.

notes.title: Conditions need informed review
notes.quote: probation for a period of 12 months
notes.explanation: Probation and shift conditions are terms to understand, not standalone fraud indicators.

notes.title: Partial document and no authentication
notes.quote: Only page 1 provided (cuts off at 2. Other Benefits); no sender email, CIN or signatory visible; Annexures III and VI not provided.
notes.explanation: The supplied notes describe one page; no original page was actually supplied to this app. Remaining terms and issuer authenticity are unknown.

questions: Can Wipro's official recruitment channel confirm the exact offer?
Can you provide all pages and Annexures III and VI?
What are the fixed and variable compensation conditions?
What are the probation, transfer and shift obligations?
Who is the authorized signatory and what official channel confirms the joining date?
